verdict.rationale: Docs show concrete retrieval-steering options: hybrid search mode (`searchMode: 'hybrid'`) combining memories and document chunks, container-tag scoping that acts as a hard metadata filter/namespace boundary, and three distinct retrieval paths (document RAG search, memory graph traversal, user profile) that developers can choose between instead of one fixed similarity search. Missing for 10: explicit keyword-only search mode, a dedicated reranking parameter/feature, and independent/hands-on confirmation of these modes beyond vendor docs.
